Frequently asked questions

Which connector should I choose?

Pick the plug that matches your device: USB-C for most new phones, tablets and laptops, Lightning for iPhones and iPads with a Lightning port, or 3.5 mm for anything with a headphone jack. You choose it when you add ChromeFones to your cart.

Do I need to charge them or pair them?

No. ChromeFones is wired, so there is no battery and no Bluetooth pairing. Plug it in and it works straight away.

Will the inline remote work with my device?

The + and − keys, the play/pause button and the mic work with most phones, tablets and laptops that support wired headsets. Exact button behaviour can vary slightly between devices.

What do I get in the pack of two?

Two pairs of ChromeFones for ₹799, which works out to ₹399.50 per pair. Both pairs come with the same connector.

How can I pay?

Pay in full by UPI, using any UPI app or a QR code. Or choose cash on delivery: pay 50% of the total now by UPI to confirm your order, and the other 50% in cash when it arrives.

How long does delivery take?

Orders are dispatched within 3–5 days. After dispatch, standard delivery is free and takes 3–6 days. Read the full .

What if they don’t suit me?

You can return your ChromeFones within 30 days of delivery. See the and for the details.

Is there a warranty?

Yes. Every ChromeFones has a 12-month warranty against manufacturing defects. Physical damage, water damage and misuse are not covered.

How do I look after the chrome finish?

Wipe it with a dry microfibre cloth and keep the earphones in their clear case when you are not using them, to avoid scratches.
